title: Ségovie / Touchscreen systems
intro: 10 interactive Windows touchscreen kiosks for a press event.
challenge: The original requirement was for ten identical touchscreen all-in-one computers, with strict installation, demo and return timing.
approach: Local supplier search across Spain and France; comparable quotes; technical specification checks; supplier coordination and direct client billing. The selected supplier was SB Service.

title: Lyon / Live brand activation
intro: A six-dancer flash-mob brief for an exhibitor at Piscine Global.
challenge: An exhibitor needed a synchronized performance with a reference choreography and a narrow on-stand time slot.
approach: Sourced an experienced local crew, clarified choreography, access, schedule, soundtrack, rehearsal needs and logistics.

title: Montpellier / Two-container deployment
intro: Two containers. Ten handlers. Four days of coordinated movement and assembly.
challenge: Two freight containers of office furniture had to be unloaded, carried to several floors, distributed and assembled on site within four days.
approach: Recruited and organized ten handling profiles, coordinated equipment, site logistics, delivery flow and furniture assembly across floors.

title: Madrid / Android tablet sourcing
intro: Two near-13-inch Android tablets with mobile data and display connectivity.
challenge: The specification required Android, preferably Samsung, mobile connectivity, stands and TV projection—not standard Wi-Fi-only tablets.
approach: Built a shortlist of Spanish rental companies, checked model compatibility, mobile-data availability and delivery options.

title: Barcelona / MWC travel operations
intro: A coordinated travel and local transport plan for three overseas delegates.
challenge: Three visitors needed flights, hotel options, transfers and arrival/departure coordination around a busy international congress.
approach: Developed travel scenarios, budget estimates and supplier requirements; bookings and delivery depend on client approval.

title: UK / Trade-site operations
intro: Local labour, equipment and site logistics for a cross-border deployment.
challenge: An overseas team needed operational support for site setup, equipment access and coordination without relocating its entire crew.
approach: Team experience spanning liaison with site management, local workforce sourcing, vehicle/equipment rental and shipment reception.

title: Montpellier / Post-show storage
intro: Urgent handling of materials left in storage after a previous exhibition.
challenge: An exhibitor had goods remaining in storage long after the event, causing unnecessary expense.
approach: Arranged local operational help to inspect, move and resolve the materials situation.

title: Paris / Exhibition sales presence
intro: Commercial presence and multilingual discussions with trade-show visitors.
challenge: The exhibiting brand needed to engage prospects and hold productive conversations across language barriers.
approach: Client-facing multilingual representation, visitor conversations and collection of commercial contacts.

title: Bordeaux / Business negotiations
intro: Cross-cultural commercial discussions for an overseas brand.
challenge: Negotiations were slowed by language differences and fragmented communication among stakeholders.
approach: Supported communication and discussions between local contacts and the overseas team.

title: Montpellier / Outdoor trade fair
intro: Commercial interactions for an outdoor-products exhibitor.
challenge: International exhibitors needed a commercially capable local presence at a French professional event.
approach: Supported conversations, visitor outreach and on-the-ground business representation.

title: France / Market discovery visits
intro: Commercial itinerary and introductions beyond the exhibition stand.
challenge: After attending an event, an international company wanted to understand the local market and meet relevant business contacts.
approach: Prepared a sequence of market visits, supported communication and accompanied commercial discussions.

title: Europe / Interactive event displays
intro: Specialized display coordination for overseas brand activations.
challenge: Highly specific exhibition equipment requires exact technical compatibility and responsive local suppliers.
approach: Supported sourcing and cross-language coordination for on-site audiovisual requirements.

title: China / Professional equipment sourcing
intro: Supplier discovery for specialist business and event equipment.
challenge: European buyers often need factory options, specifications and comparable offers without having their own sourcing team in China.
approach: China-side contacts can assist with manufacturer search, specification checks and supplier communication. Project-specific verification is required.

title: Paris / Maison&Objet exhibitors
intro: Operational and commercial support designed for international exhibitors.
challenge: Overseas companies preparing a French exhibition may need local suppliers, staff and meeting support.
approach: Commercial prospecting and offer preparation; no completed client project claimed.

title: Paris / Equip Auto 2027
intro: A future programme for exhibitors seeking local execution support.
challenge: Cross-border exhibitors often need coordinated teams, equipment, logistics and business meetings.
approach: Early-stage market prospecting and partner mapping. No booked or delivered assignment claimed.
